output.answer: As of November 11, 2026, NBCUniversal is itself a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Its principal operating businesses and brands include NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, Peacock, Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, Focus Features, Universal Studio Group, and Universal Destinations & Experiences (including Universal Orlando Resort and Universal Studios Hollywood). The complete legal-entity answer is much longer: Comcast’s latest subsidiary exhibit, filed February 3, 2026 for fiscal year 2025, lists entities such as NBCUniversal Media, LLC, NBCUniversal, LLC, NBCUniversal International Limited, NBCUniversal Production Services LLC, and NBCUniversal Shared Services, LLC, among many others.
caveats: “Subsidiary” can mean a legal entity or a principal operating business/brand; NBCUniversal’s public About page primarily names the latter, while Exhibit 21 is the legal-entity list.
The SEC exhibit contains a very large list of legal entities rather than a short, curated NBCUniversal-only brand list; the examples above are not exhaustive.
The NBCUniversal About page is undated, so its page date could not be verified; the legal-entity list is current to the February 3, 2026 Comcast filing and may have changed by November 11, 2026.

passages.quote: NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation.

We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood.

output.question: What are NBCUniversal's subsidiaries?

key_facts.fact: NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation.

NBCUniversal's principal operating portfolio includes NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, Peacock, Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, Focus Features, Universal Studio Group, and Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort and Universal Studios Hollywood.
Comcast's latest Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025, filed February 3, 2026, includes Exhibit 21, a list of subsidiaries.

Examples appearing in the latest legal-entity list include NBCUniversal Media, LLC, NBCUniversal, LLC, NBCUniversal International Limited, NBCUniversal Production Services LLC, and NBCUniversal Shared Services, LLC.
